February 13, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-13-1971-55346

Following an 1:30-hour meeting at Hotel Purbani, Awami League Chief Sheikh Mujibur Rahman comes to an agreement with Nawab Akbar Khan Bugti, political leader of Baluchistan, on implementing the governance policy based on 6-point. Replying to a question, he tells journalists that 6-point is not only for Bangladesh, it is also applicable to Baluchistan and other provinces.

Pakistan People’s Party Chairman Zulfikar Ali Bhutto meets President General AM Yahya Khan at Presidential Palace in Rawalpindi. They discuss on constitutional matters.

East Pakistan government passes directive on prices and distribution of daily commodities. The directive ‘East Pakistan Daily Commodities Prices and Distribution Act-1970’ is to be effective immediately.
